basis: Preserves the existing 60 L reference fuel accounting exactly. Estimated internal box fits within visible 0.696 x 0.490 x 0.306 m tank envelope. Wall thickness, baffles, usable volume and as-built interior not measured.
surface_model: Gravity-horizontal quasi-static free surface clipped against a rigid box; ignores dynamic slosh, acceleration-induced surface tilt, baffles and fluid momentum relative to the vessel.
mass_flux_model: Slow consumed fuel exits carrying local vessel velocity; no exhaust jet reaction. Body generalized velocities remain continuous when inertia changes.
